svg.text: SETTINGS WHERE A KEYWORD-ALPHABET PAIR FITS, THE CELLS WITH K4 NEAREST THE TOP (ALL 100 CELLS IN THE RECORD)
Smallest p 0.02 of 100 cells, about what chance gives. The A10 fits are one setting where the first six checks repeat
known letters: its pairs were counted, not verified (F14.2a reruns 41,986 such settings).
